title: Improve developer onboarding: SDKs, docs, and one-click quickstarts
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: Reduce time-to-first-success for new engineers evaluating Redwood APIs by improving official SDKs, consolidating docs, and shipping opinionated one-click quickstarts. Scope: (1) Stabilize JS/TS and Python SDKs with better error surface and examples; (2) Rewrite core getting-started docs to a single path for evaluation → prototype → production; (3) Add cloud-backed one-click quickstarts for GitHub repos and Codespaces templates; (4) Telemetry & funnels to measure ttf-success and retention. Success metrics: median time-to-first-success <= 15 minutes, 30-day activation rate +20% for self-serve signups using quickstarts, SDK runtime errors reduced by 50% for top-5 error classes. This ticket tracks initiative-level work: PRD, cross-team alignment, launch checklist, and measurement dashboards.
comments: 2025-02-11 — Kickoff: Align with Eng (Marco Ruiz) and Design (Tara Singh). Agreed scope prioritizes JS/TS SDK and Python SDK first, then Go SDK (Phase 2). Action: Eng to submit compatibility matrix by 2025-02-18.

2025-02-18 — Engineering update (Marco): Compatibility matrix submitted. Major risk: current streaming API surface differs across SDKs; we discussed converging on a single streaming iterator pattern. Trade-off: small breaking change vs long-term consistency. Decision: go with iterator pattern; deprecation window of 2 releases.

2025-02-24 — Design review (Tara): Provided new onboarding UX flow and quickstart templates. Feedback: reduce copy in getting-started, surface errors inline. Action: Design to upload Figma frames and copy deck. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/redwood/devex/pm-4927-design

2025-03-01 — PM note (Aisha): Draft PRD posted to Confluence. Link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/DEVEX/PM-4927+Onboarding+Initiative. Key deliverables listed in PRD; added rollout gating criteria and measurement plan. Requesting Eng and DX review by 2025-03-07.

2025-03-03 — Eng review (Lina): Raised one blocker: CI for quickstart templates currently takes >30m to provision in Codespaces. Mitigation: add fixture-based smaller integration tests for initial rollout and schedule CI improvements for post-launch. Created ENG-2249 to track CI perf work.

2025-03-04 — Legal/Security check: Initial review complete. No high-risk data flows in quickstarts; recommend including opt-in telemetry notice. Assigned follow-up to PM to update docs. Link to security notes: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SEC/DevEx+Telemetry+Notes

2025-03-05 — Measurement (QA): Analytics dashboard skeleton pushed. Link to dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/DevEx/onboarding-funnels?orgId=1. Initial events: quickstart_initiated, quickstart_completed, sdk_error, first_generation_success. PM to confirm event names with Eng.

Post-launch checklist (pending): 1) Publish stable SDK releases and changelogs; 2) Merge getting-started doc into docs site; 3) Publish GitHub quickstart repos with templates; 4) Enable funnel alerts for regressions. Assigned owners listed in PRD.
Open questions: How to prioritize docs localization for non-English regions? Suggest pilot in EMEA with translated short-read docs in next cycle.
